COLLECTION PHOTOGRAPHS — attribution and reuse

Each converted image retains its source licence. CC BY-SA conversions are offered under the exact same licence shown. Other game files are separate works, not sublicensed by this image manifest.

stegosaurus: Stegosaurus ungulatus.jpg
Photographer: Perry Quan
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Stegosaurus_ungulatus.jpg
Licence: CC-BY-SA-2.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/
Changes: Resized proportionally to at most 1600 px wide and converted to WebP quality 87. No crop, compositing, retouching or generated content.
Image note: Stegosaurus ungulatus mount at the Carnegie Museum. Source version was cropped on Commons by FunkMonk/Cropbot; game adds no further crop. Flickr licence verified 20 August 2013.

brachiosaurus: Brontosaurus Yale Peabody.jpg
Photographer: Ad Meskens
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Brontosaurus_Yale_Peabody.jpg
Licence: CC-BY-SA-3.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
Changes: Resized proportionally to at most 1600 px wide and converted to WebP quality 87. No crop, compositing, retouching or generated content.
Image note: Brontosaurus excelsus type specimen YPM 1980 at Yale Peabody Museum, photographed 2 April 2012. Historical mount with reconstructed parts, before the later neck/tail remount. Commons source cropped by FunkMonk/Cropbot in 2014; the game adds no crop. Internal brachiosaurus slot retained for save compatibility.

spinosaurus: Field Spinosaurus.jpg
Photographer: 3blindMies
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Field_Spinosaurus.jpg
Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Changes: Resized proportionally to at most 1600 px wide and converted to WebP quality 87. No crop, compositing, retouching or generated content.
Image note: 2023 cast of FSAC-KK-11888 in swimming posture. Includes modern broad tail reconstruction; the precise swimming/foraging behaviour remains debated.

parasaurolophus: Parasaurolophus at FMNH.jpg
Photographer: Jonathan Chen
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Parasaurolophus_at_FMNH.jpg
Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Changes: Resized proportionally to at most 1600 px wide and converted to WebP quality 87. No crop, compositing, retouching or generated content.
Image note: Type specimen of Parasaurolophus cyrtocristatus mounted at the Field Museum, photographed 2018. Its shorter curved crest differs from the game reconstruction of a longer-crested Parasaurolophus.
